svg.title: Bar chart of hashing throughput at 16 MiB. blake3_ffi (this package), 2226 MB per second; crypto 3.0.7 sha256, 167 MB per second; blake3_dart 1.0.0 (pure Dart), 100 MB per second. That is 22.2 times the pure-Dart path.
svg.text: BLAKE3 at 16 MiB: native FFI against the pure-Dart path
Apple M4 Pro, Dart 3.11.0. Fastest of 5 batches in the fastest of 3 placements; MB/s is 1,000,000 bytes per second.
22.2x the pure-Dart path and 13.3x SHA-256, out of the same NEON kernel the reference implementation ships.
Both BLAKE3 rows return identical digests; bench/bench.dart checks that before it times anything.
